Actor Defends 'Ramayana' Film Amid Criticism

Actor Saurabh Sachdeva has defended the film 'Ramayana', stating it was made with care and authenticity. He compared criticism of the film to blaming the epic 'Ramayana' for real-world violent incidents, referencing a recent chainsaw attack in Andhra Pradesh. Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma also defended violence in films in the context of the AP incident.
